Name: Imperial Lion Penny Loafer
Short description: Imperial Lion Penny Loafer premium shoes
Description:
Materials

            
Full-grain calfskin leather uppers, leather-lined for breathability, with a natural leather sole for flexibility and long-term comfort.

        

        

            

 Goodyear Welt Construction

            
Built using the traditional Goodyear welt method — the upper, lining, and a leather welt are stitched together, then the welt is stitched to the sole. This makes the shoe fully resoleable and built to last for decades with proper care.

        

        

            

 Care Guide

            
Wipe with a soft, dry cloth after each wear. Use a horn shoe tree to hold shape while stored. Condition the leather every 4–6 weeks with a quality leather cream, and polish before important occasions. Avoid prolonged exposure to water and direct heat.
